CLASS 45 · FAMILY & FRIENDS · CARD 22 OF 35

Nephew

A nephew is a boy somebody proudly calls their nephew — the son of their sister or brother. Aunts and uncles of nephews get to hand out extra cookies.

On the card

“Nephew” — printed in big blue letters over five happy nephews waving in blue.

Who they are

A nephew is your sister or brother’s son — or the boy side of your family calls you one! Nephews are the kids aunts and uncles brag about.

Try it today

If you have a nephew — or an aunt or uncle — send them a message or a drawing today. Family miles shrink fast.

Keep going

Nephew is card 22 of 35 in the Family & Friends class. Print it for the fridge, then hop back to the class page to meet the next person.

PART OF THE CLASS

Thirty-five people, one big family.

Nephew is one of 35 family and friends words for ages 4–5.
